engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Charisma is the Oracle class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Oracle levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Charisma modifier). Revelation attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. Revelation save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier.

HIT DIE CONFLICT. The class overview registry lists d8, while the detailed Player Rulebook Oracle entry states 6 + Constitution modifier at level 1 and d6 per Oracle level thereafter. This pilot uses the detailed rulebook d6 chassis: 6 + Constitution modifier at Oracle 1 and 1d6 per later Oracle level. The d8 registry value remains a preserved alternative pending owner adjudication.

The Oracle is an exceptional progression class rather than a 25-choice Base/Arch/Hero class. Base Oracle is levels 1-2, Revelation Tier development is the Arch-stage progression at levels 3-9, and Revelation Mastery is the Hero-stage progression at levels 10-20. Mystery and Curse are chosen at level 1 but their later Revelations, Boons and Final abilities remain class-level gated.

Choose exactly ONE Mystery and exactly ONE Curse at Oracle level 1. They are not parallel subclasses that stack. You never gain another Mystery or Curse unless a future explicit retraining or transformation rule says otherwise. Curse limitations are permanent and cannot be removed by ordinary cleansing, curse removal, resurrection or rest.

REVELATION CHARGES are the Oracle's only class power resource. Oracles do not use Resonance Points, spell slots, Weave Dissonance, Overcast or ordinary spell-rank casting for Revelations. Revelation Charges are abbreviated RC. A Revelation card's printed RC cost is paid once before resolution. An illegal activation spends nothing.

RC CAP SCHEDULE for this provisional module: maximum 3 at Oracle levels 1-2, 4 at levels 3-5, 5 at levels 6-8, 6 at levels 9-10 and 7 at level 11+. Increasing the maximum does not automatically refill spent charges except where another feature explicitly says so.

RC RECOVERY. A completed long rest restores RC to maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent RC, never above maximum. Each Mystery has exactly one Prophecy Trigger. During a real encounter, your Prophecy Trigger can restore at most 1 RC per round and never above maximum. Trivial enemies, willing staged targets, summoned sacrifices, repeated corpse abuse, copied damage, copied healing and events generated solely to trigger recovery do not qualify.

A single event can satisfy only one Prophecy Trigger recovery for you even if several descriptions could apply. A Revelation repeated or copied by another feature does not independently trigger Prophecy recovery unless that feature explicitly says it counts as a new Revelation use. Restored charges never recursively trigger another recovery.

At Oracle level 11, the preserved registry draft additionally sets your starting RC when a real encounter begins to at least max(3, your Charisma modifier), capped by your current RC maximum. If you already have more RC, keep the higher current value. This encounter-start floor occurs once per encounter and cannot be triggered by staged initiative.

REVELATIONS are divine class techniques, not ordinary spells. Unless a Revelation explicitly says otherwise, magical silence does not prevent a purely mental Revelation, but a Revelation requiring speech, touch, visible symbolism or another listed component obeys that requirement. Revelations do not generate Dissonance and cannot be modified by spell-slot, RP, spell-rank discount or ordinary spell-proc mechanics.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time unless a specific Oracle feature explicitly creates a narrow exception. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration procedure; if half-damage rounding is required in this pilot, round down. Sustained Revelation control effects grant repeat saves at the cadence printed on the Revelation.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Oracle-caused full-turn denial such as Stunned, Paralyzed, Incapacitated by control, or loss of its full Action from your Oracle features per encounter. After that succeeds once, later Oracle effects from you that would fully deny its turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. An additional Action cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Features that say a creature acts out of turn use this same cap. Movement-only grants do not count as additional full Actions.

Healing from Oracle features cannot exceed maximum HP, resurrect the dead or remove Wounds unless a feature explicitly says so. Temporary HP never stack. Encounter-only regeneration and drain cannot be farmed outside meaningful combat. Corpse effects create no XP, loot, RC or repeatable corpse resources unless expressly stated.

Copied, echoed, repeated or redirected damage/healing uses only the explicitly copied numeric component. It cannot repeat RC recovery, Prophecy Triggers, action grants, conditions, passive triggers, resource restoration or another copy effect unless the copying feature explicitly says otherwise.

BASE PROGRESSION. At Oracle 1 choose Mystery and Curse; gain the RC engine, Channel Revelation, Prophetic Insight and Divine Sense. At Oracle 2 gain Curse Manifestation, Oracular Trance and Oracle's Burden. No Base feature-selection currency or Skill Points are used.

ARCH-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 3: choose one Tier I Revelation from your Mystery and automatically gain Curse Boon I. Oracle 4: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 5: automatically gain Curse Boon II; any Mystery-specific level-5 feature recorded by the registry belongs to the Mystery module below and does not create an additional generic feature here. Oracle 6: choose one Tier II Revelation and gain Mystery Surge. Oracle 8: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 9: gain your Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation.

HERO-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 10: gain Curse Boon III and Grand Revelation Foreshadow. Oracle 11: RC cap reaches 7 and the preserved encounter-start RC floor becomes active. Oracle 12: gain the Mystery-specific Mystic Insight. Oracle 13: preserved registry draft grants a second Tier II Revelation; after each completed short rest choose which of your two Tier II Revelations is Attuned for features that specifically refer to an active Tier II option, though both remain known and usable. Oracle 14: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 15: gain Revelation Mastery and Curse Boon IV. Oracle 16: preserved Prophecy Trigger Mastery. Oracle 17: preserved Grand Revelation Foreshadow upgrade. Oracle 18: Prophetic Surge. Oracle 19: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 20: gain the Mystery's Final Revelation and Curse Boon V.

REVELATION MASTERY at level 15 never grants a Revelation you do not know. Choose one mastery enhancement explicitly listed by your Mystery for a Revelation you know. If a listed mastery names a Revelation you did not select, that mastery option is unavailable. Mastery cannot reduce RC below 0, create additional Actions beyond the shared cap or remove repeat-save requirements unless its exact Mystery text says so.

PROPHECY AND DIVINATION never force player beliefs, future choices or confessions. Information features can provide truthful clues, likely outcomes, symbolic visions or current facts, but the Director is not required to reveal unknowable future player decisions. Effects that command or compel a player-controlled character preserve the player's choice of targets and prohibit self-harm, permanent allegiance changes and belief alteration.

CURSE MANIFESTATION provides a common operational intensification rather than ten different hidden sub-engines. When activated, your Curse becomes visibly or metaphysically dominant for 3 rounds: gain +1 on Revelation attacks and +1 to Revelation save DC, but take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws for the duration. Any Curse limitation that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed during Manifestation.

CURSE BOONS are automatic at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 for your ONE selected Curse. You do not choose between Curse Boons and do not gain Boons from unselected Curses. Each Curse card below operationalizes all five Boon gates and its permanent limitations.

All class gates use Oracle class level, not total character level. Normal proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. Non-Oracle levels do not raise RC maximum, unlock Curse Boons, Revelations, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery, Prophetic Surge or Final Revelation.

INTEGRATION PRECEDENCE. The source ceiling draft conflicts with the registry on short rests and extra Revelation activations. This pilot explicitly chooses 1 RC on a completed short rest and permits a second Revelation only through an expressly granted extra Action or double-cast feature, never more than two Revelation resolutions per round. The preserved ceiling alternative is no short-rest recovery and one activation per round; do not combine both configurations.

All combat-triggered RC refunds, including Prophecy, damage riders and Curse Boons, share ONE recovered RC per round. Rest recovery, encounter-start floor and explicitly limited Final refills are separate. A free, copied or refunded use cannot recursively trigger another recovery. Apply this global cap even if an individual card says its recovery is separate.

The shared Prophetic Surge and your Mystery-specific level-18 Prophecy are two descriptions/options of ONE long-rest use, not two charges. Framework cards such as Tier III, Mystic Insight, Mastery and Final Revelation unlock the named Mystery card and never grant duplicate uses. A level-5 registry Mystery label grants no extra unnamed ability.

Oracle zone default: choose at most three allies and three enemies for each pulse or aura benefit, fixed at activation unless the card names fewer. Persistent damaging/healing zones require concentration and at most three pulses. Pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first, or end the effect; once-per-long-rest Finals include their printed pulses in that limited use. One pulse can affect a creature only once per round. Passive personal resistance and a single-target temporary buff are not zones.

Revelation backlash is the local one-turn penalty of -1 to attacks and saves and -5 feet Speed, ending at the end of your next turn. It is not a level of the general Exhaustion condition. Wound Eater's missed-feeding Exhaustion remains the general condition.

Initiative adjustments change order beginning next round. They never produce or erase a regular turn in the current round; a creature still gets at most one regular turn each round. Ties use the original initiative order. Fixed encounter-start bonuses do not retroactively reorder an encounter.

Extra attacks and echoed damage use base weapon/spell dice before critical-hit extra dice. A redirected damage event cannot be reduced a second time, reflected again or generate RC. Charmed alone does not grant command of a creature's actions.

Oracle’s exceptional ASI/feat schedule is 4, 8, 14 and 19. It does not gain extra ASIs at 12 or 16 from the generic class schedule. The rejected five-milestone draft remains in supersededPlaytestOverrides for traceability.
workedExample: Oracle 5 example: Charisma 16 gives M=3, PB=3 and S=2. The Oracle has maximum RC 4 under the pilot schedule, begins a real encounter at RC4, selected Spiral-Touched as the Curse, and knows one Tier I Revelation costing 1 RC.
Turn 1: use the known Tier I Revelation for 1 RC, so RC4→3. Suppose its Mystery Prophecy Trigger does not occur. Because Revelations use RC only, no RP, spell slot, Burn or Dissonance value changes.

Turn 2: use Curse Manifestation as a Bonus Action for 1 RC, RC3→2. For 3 rounds the Oracle gains +1 to Revelation attacks and save DC but suffers -1 AC and -1 on its own saving throws. The permanent Spiral-Touched limitations continue.

Enemy turn: the Oracle fails a saving throw. Spiral-Touched Curse Boon I is already unlocked at Oracle 3, so once per long rest the Oracle rerolls that failed save and uses the new result. This reroll costs no RC.

Turn 3: Spiral-Touched Curse Boon II is unlocked at Oracle 5. Spend 1 RC to take its once-per-combat out-of-turn Action after another creature finishes its turn, RC2→1. This uses the universal one-additional-full-Action-per-round allowance and cannot generate another extra Action.
After combat, a completed short rest restores 1 RC, RC1→2. A long rest would instead restore the Oracle to the current maximum of4. Neither rest removes the Spiral-Touched Curse.
balanceQuestions: Does the provisional RC cap schedule 3→4→5→6→7, combined with short-rest recovery, Prophecy Triggers and the level-11 encounter-start floor, sustain Revelations without making charge management irrelevant?

Do Curse limitations remain meaningful after their Boons accumulate, especially for Spiral-Touched, Wound Eater, Shattered Mind and False Life, without producing excessive involuntary turn loss or noninteractive penalties?
Do the shared hard-control and additional-Action caps adequately contain Time, Tongues, Shattered Mind and other future Mystery interactions while preserving each Curse's identity?

extraCards.effect: Gain the Revelation Charge resource. Maximum RC follows the pilot schedule: 3 at Oracle1-2, 4 at3-5, 5 at6-8, 6 at9-10 and7 at11+. Long rest restores all RC; short rest restores1. Mystery Prophecy Triggers restore at most1 RC per round in meaningful encounters.

extraCards.effect: Choose exactly one Mystery: Ancestor, Battle, Bones, Cataclysm, Dream, Flame, Life, Shadow, Stars or Time. It determines your Prophecy Trigger, level-1 Mystery identity, Revelation choices, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery options, Prophetic Surge variant and Final Revelation. The Mystery cards below define those features.

extraCards.effect: Choose exactly one Curse from the ten Curse cards below. Its limitations apply immediately and cannot be removed by ordinary magic or rest. Its Boons unlock automatically at Oracle levels3,5,10,15 and20.

extraCards.cost: Use the Revelation's printed RC cost

Use that Revelation's printed activation, target, range, RC cost, duration, recharge and save/attack procedure. extraCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until used

You must choose which roll receives the advantage before rolling it. This grants no knowledge of another player's future choice.

extraCards.effect: For 1 minute sense the presence, approximate direction and broad nature of divine, undead and extraplanar creatures or active presences within60 feet that are not behind an effect specifically blocking divination. You learn only broad categories such as celestial/divine, undead, fiendish, fey, elemental or other extraplanar, not identity, alignment, statistics or intentions.

extraCards.effect: Intensify your chosen Curse. For3 rounds gain +1 on Revelation attack rolls and +1 to your Revelation save DC. For the same duration take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws. Any part of the selected Curse that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed while Manifestation lasts.

extraCards.name: Oracle's Burden
extraCards.effect: Your selected Curse is recognized as an intrinsic Oracle class condition rather than an ordinary removable curse. This cannot force another creature to fail a saving throw, override immunity, create a critical hit or bypass an impossible task.

extraCards.effect: When activating a known Revelation, choose one: reduce that Revelation's RC cost to0 for this use; or, if it has a printed duration of 1-3 rounds, extend that duration by1 round while preserving all normal repeat-save and maintenance cadence. extraCards.name: Ability Score Improvement — Oracle 19
extraCards.effect: Choose the campaign's normal Ability Score Improvement option or one eligible feat.

extraCards.name: Spiral-Touched
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: your temporal dislocation is obvious in conversation. Once per real encounter, at the start of each of your regular turns until this occurs, roll d20; on1 you lose your Bonus Action and Reaction for that turn as you desynchronize, but retain Action and movement. You have disadvantage on ability checks requiring more than 10 uninterrupted minutes of mundane concentration. BOON I — Oracle3: +3 initiative; 1/long rest reroll one failed save and use the new result. BOON II — Oracle5: resistance to explicitly time/aging damage and advantage on saves against aging/slow effects; once per encounter spend1 RC after another creature finishes its turn to take one additional full Action immediately, subject to the global action cap. BOON III — Oracle10: 1/long rest when damage would reduce you to0 HP without killing you outright, instead regain floor(max HP/4), minimum1, and phase out until the start of your next regular turn; while phased you cannot be targeted, affect other creatures or activate Revelations. BOON IV — Oracle15: once per encounter gain one additional full Action on your turn, subject to the common cap. Also, once per round when an attack hits you, roll d10; on1 it instead strikes a temporal echo and misses. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest as a Reaction before the fourth round of the encounter begins, rewind the current encounter to its initiative-start snapshot: restore combatant positions, HP, temporary HP, conditions, RC and per-encounter uses to that snapshot. Short-/long-rest uses, physical consumables and this Time Loop use remain spent. Slain encounter participants return to their snapshot state and no duplicate XP, treasure or consumables are created. Allies retain memory of the previous timeline. Time Loop does not restore RP, Ki, Conviction, Blood Gauge, device stock, healing reserves or any other daily/rest resource; only the named RC and per-encounter states rewind. No loot changes ownership through rewinding. Record the snapshot at initiative; if no complete snapshot exists, this option is unavailable and unspent. It cannot undo a previous encounter or duplicate a per-rest use.

extraCards.name: Wound Eater
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: HP recovery from rests and from another creature's healing is halved, rounded down; your own Wound Eater drains and your own Revelations are not halved. Before a long rest completes, you must have successfully drained HP from a meaningful hostile living creature since your previous long rest or gain one level of Exhaustion after the rest. Your corpse-like appearance imposes disadvantage on the first friendly social check with an unfamiliar mortal who can clearly see you, unless circumstances make the appearance irrelevant. BOON I — Oracle3: once per turn in a real encounter after your weapon or touch attack damages a living non-construct enemy, pay 1 RC to drain 1d6 HP; you regain half the actual drain rounded down. BOON II — Oracle5: once per round when you reduce a meaningful living hostile to0 HP, regain1 RC; gain resistance to necrotic damage from non-Revelation sources. BOON III — Oracle10: 1/short rest as an Action touch one dying hostile living creature at0 HP; that creature dies and you regain HP equal to one-quarter your maximum HP rounded down. It cannot trigger from summoned, trivial or staged creatures and removes no Wounds. BOON IV — Oracle15: pay 2 RC as a Bonus Action to activate a 10-foot drain aura, requiring concentration for at most three pulses; pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first or end it. You may suppress it freely. During a real encounter, at the start of your turn up to three meaningful living enemies in the aura takes S necrotic damage; regain HP equal to the total actually dealt, capped at S+M per turn. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest as an Action, up to three meaningful living enemies within20 feet lose HP equal to the lesser of one-quarter their maximum HP or Oracle level+M; you regain half the total actual HP lost, capped at one-half your maximum HP. Allies, constructs, undead, trivial creatures and summons are unaffected.

extraCards.name: Soul-Cracked
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination that attempts to read your alignment, aura or intent returns inconsistent results unless it specifically overcomes Oracle curses. Once each encounter, before your first damaging Revelation resolves, roll d6: 1 fire, 2 cold, 3 lightning, 4 necrotic, 5 psychic, 6 radiant; that Revelation's damage becomes the rolled type. While subject to a geas, binding oath or magically enforced pact, the first time each turn you knowingly act against its terms you take S psychic damage. BOON I — Oracle3: immune to Charmed effects whose purpose is compulsion or domination; 1/long rest reroll one failed save against another mind-affecting effect. BOON II — Oracle5: once per encounter before a damaging Revelation, spend no additional RC and choose fire, cold, lightning, necrotic, psychic or radiant; change that Revelation's damage to the chosen type. Until it resolves, divination attempting to read your intent returns blank. BOON III — Oracle10: 1/long rest when another creature would Charm or dominate you, negate that effect against you and force the source to make a Wisdom save against your Revelation DC; on failure it becomes Charmed by you until the end of its next turn, with no belief or permanent allegiance change. BOON IV — Oracle15: resistance to psychic damage and +2 on saves against mind-control effects. Divination directly targeting you rolls d2; on1 it returns a contradictory but non-fabricated symbolic result rather than actionable information. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest as an Action end one curse, geas or possession on yourself or one willing ally within15 feet if that effect is not explicitly artifact/plot-locked. If its originator is a creature on the same plane, it makes a Wisdom save, taking 3S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success.

extraCards.name: Haunted
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: take -2 on Stealth checks in haunted locations or crowded civilized spaces where the attending spirits can manifest. Once per tense social scene the Director may call for a DC10 Wisdom save; on failure a spirit speaks through you and you have disadvantage on your next social check in that scene. Addressing absent or not-yet-present people remains a roleplaying manifestation. BOON I — Oracle3: +1 AC against the first attack made against you each round; 1/long rest when initiative begins, declare the spirits' warning and you cannot be Surprised in that encounter. BOON IV — Oracle15: 1/long rest as an Action, enemies of your choice within15 feet make Wisdom saves; failure causes Dread for up to2 rounds, giving -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. Affected creatures repeat the save at the end of each turn, ending Dread on success. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest summon one spirit scout for10 minutes. It can travel along a route you have personally traveled on the same plane, up to1 mile from you, observe with ordinary sight/hearing, speak with willing dead spirits it encounters and deliver one short prophetic message. On return it truthfully reports what it directly observed and may identify one unexpected creature or person's name it actually encountered. It cannot pass sealed planar barriers, read minds or reveal unknowable facts.

You may suppress it as an Action for10 minutes; while suppressed you cannot use Tongues Boons requiring supernatural speech. extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: once per round when slashing or piercing damage deals actual HP damage to you, your blood ignites: you and hostile creatures within5 feet each take1d4 fire damage. You cannot gain cold resistance from a beneficial spell, item or class feature and cold-tagged healing restores0 HP to you. extraCards.name: False Life
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination treats you as undead unless it specifically pierces Oracle curses. Before a healing spell from another creature restores HP to you, its caster may make Wisdom (Insight) against your Revelation save DC. On success healing works normally. On failure roll d2; on1 the spell restores0 HP to you but still expends its normal costs. Non-spell healing is unaffected. Social hesitation from life-focused clergy remains narrative unless the scene calls for an ordinary reaction check. BOON I — Oracle3: advantage on saves against death effects and hostile necrotic/negative-energy effects. 1/long rest when you would die from failed death saves or be reduced to0 by an effect that does not kill outright, remain at1 HP instead. BOON II — Oracle5: once per encounter as an Action feign perfect death for up to1 minute. You remain conscious but cannot move, speak, take Actions or Reactions; ordinary undead ignore you unless you attack or otherwise reveal yourself. End the effect voluntarily at the start of your turn. BOON III — Oracle10: 1/long rest when reduced to0 HP without instant death, remain conscious until the end of your next regular turn. During that turn choose either move up to your Speed, speak normally or activate one Revelation; you cannot do more than one of those options. If still at0 afterward, become unconscious normally. BOON IV — Oracle15: resistance to necrotic damage. Once per round when an undead creature hits you with an attack, roll d10; on1 the attack misses instead as it mistakes you for kin. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest when you are at0 HP but not destroyed outright, appear dead until the start of your next regular turn. During that interval you are incapacitated. At the start of your next turn rise with floor(max HP/4), minimum1, and gain necrotic immunity for2 rounds. Undead within15 feet treat you as non-hostile until you damage, control or overtly oppose them. Divination during the apparent-death interval returns one false but plausible state-description you choose; it cannot fabricate events outside your own condition.

extraCards.name: Shattered Mind
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: take -2 on concentration saves. Once per tense social scene, make a DC10 Wisdom save when the Director identifies a meaningful pressure point; on failure you involuntarily speak a brief prophetic fragment, but the player chooses wording that does not reveal protected secrets unless already known. After each long rest make a DC10 Wisdom save; failure gives fragmented memories of others' dreams, a narrative complication with no automatic mechanical penalty. BOON I — Oracle3: once per encounter choose one: move up to your Speed as a Bonus Action without provoking opportunity attacks; or activate one known Tier I Revelation using a Bonus Action instead of its normal Action. If you use the Revelation option, you cannot also take a full Action that turn. BOON II — Oracle5: +2 initiative, roll initiative twice and take the higher, and immunity to Stunned. BOON III — Oracle10: once per encounter when beginning a second sustained Revelation while one of your Revelations is already active, maintain both until the end of your next regular turn. Pay the second Revelation's normal RC cost but no additional special maintenance charge; normal concentration saves threaten both. At the end of the extension choose one sustained effect to end; starting a third ends the previous two immediately. BOON IV — Oracle15: once per short rest reroll a failed Intelligence or Wisdom ability check and use the new result; gain +2 on Insight checks made to read motives. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest gain one additional full Action during your turn, subject to the universal one-extra-Action cap. The additional Action may only activate a Revelation or be used to Dash/Move as an Action and cannot generate another Action.

extraCards.name: Consumed
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: your body increasingly displays your Mystery and imposes -2 on checks made specifically to disguise or conceal those supernatural alterations without magical assistance. Significant body changes require armor and fitted gear to be refitted during ordinary downtime at the Director's normal maintenance cost; this never destroys attuned equipment. THEME DAMAGE TYPE for this pilot: Ancestor psychic, Battle force, Bones necrotic, Cataclysm thunder, Dream psychic, Flame fire, Life radiant, Shadow psychic, Stars radiant, Time force. BOON I — Oracle3: reduce the first instance of your Mystery theme damage you take each round by PB. Once per long rest suppress visible transformation for1 hour, though divination still detects your Mystery. BOON II — Oracle5: while in light or no armor gain +1 AC. Unarmed strikes and natural weapons count as magical and once per turn deal +1d4 theme damage. BOON III — Oracle10: once on each of your turns add +1d4 theme damage to one weapon or touch attack hit. BOON IV — Oracle15: ignore nonmagical difficult terrain explicitly associated with your Mystery's theme. Allies moving within5 feet behind you during the same round may treat those spaces as normal terrain until the start of your next turn. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest as a Bonus Action fully embody your Mystery for3 rounds. Gain immunity to the theme damage type, +2 on Revelation attack rolls and Revelation save DC, and add S to one Revelation damage or healing roll each turn. Allies within10 feet gain +1 AC. Visible transformation cannot be suppressed during this embodiment.

extraCards.name: Fate-Bound
extraCards.effect: LIMITATIONS: when you voluntarily swear a specific oath or explicitly accept a prophetic obligation in play, record it. Knowingly and voluntarily breaking it costs1 RC if available and deals S d6 psychic damage; if you have0 RC you still take the damage. This never forces you to keep the oath. When the Director presents a clearly identified foreseen disaster that you previously accepted as an omen, deliberately abandoning it without confronting its immediate consequence gives -2 on saving throws until you confront the omen, the omen passes, or you complete a long rest; this is consequence, not compelled behavior. BOON I — Oracle3: 1/long rest before an ally within30 feet makes a check or save tied to a declared party decision, speak an omen and give +2 to that roll. If the party changes plans before the roll, the named ally retains the bonus for the originally described type of challenge until the end of the scene. BOON II — Oracle5: once per encounter after an attack against you is rolled but before damage, force the attacker to reroll and use the new result. BOON III — Oracle10: 1/long rest when an ally within25 feet rolls a natural1 on a saving throw, you may transfer that failed save to yourself if the effect could legally affect you. The ally treats its save as successful; you suffer the failed-save effect as though you were the target, without another save. If the effect cannot legally affect you, the transfer cannot be used. BOON IV — Oracle15: +2 on saves against death effects, banishment, forced temporal/fate displacement and effects explicitly severing a destiny bond. 1/long rest reroll one failed death save. BOON V — Oracle20: 1/long rest before one ally within30 feet makes an attack roll or saving throw, declare the exact successful outcome aloud. That roll automatically succeeds but is not automatically a critical hit. If the ally never attempts the declared roll before the encounter ends, you lose1 RC, minimum0. The prophecy cannot specify impossible secondary consequences, compel target behavior or override immunity.

extraCards.name: Ancestor Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When an ally benefits from one of your Oracle features and then lands a critical hit before the end of its next turn, regain 1 RC, never above your maximum. One critical event restores at most 1 RC and copied attacks or staged targets do not qualify.

extraCards.name: Ancestral Guardian
extraCards.effect: A spectral guardian accompanies you. Gain +1 AC against the first attack targeting you each round and +1 on saves against charm, fear and other mind-affecting control. Once per long rest when an ally within 3 tiles is targeted by a single-target attack, use your Reaction before the roll; the guardian becomes the target instead and the attack automatically hits the guardian harmlessly, then the guardian vanishes until your next long rest. The interception cannot stop area effects.

extraCards.name: Echo Voice
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 5 tiles; telepathy with willing allies within 5 tiles
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one reroll per failed roll
extraCards.effect: You may communicate telepathically with willing allies within 5 tiles. When one such ally fails an attack roll, saving throw or ability check, use your Reaction and spend 1 RC before another roll is made. That ally rerolls the failed roll with +2 and must use the new result. The reroll cannot itself trigger another Echo Voice.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Ancestral Strike
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; next weapon or touch attack before end of turn
extraCards.duration: Until end of current turn or until attack resolves
extraCards.effect: Empower your next weapon or touch attack this turn. On a hit, add damage equal to half the attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If that attack is a critical hit, the target makes a Constitution save; on failure it would be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Bloodline Sight
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds you perceive undead, invisible and ethereal creatures within 6 tiles that are not behind total cover or an effect explicitly blocking supernatural detection. Those creatures cannot gain concealment or hide from you solely through invisibility, ethereal overlap or mundane Stealth while in range. This does not expose illusions unrelated to those categories.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Spirit Walk
extraCards.effect: Your spirit leaves your body until the end of the turn. During the effect you may move through creatures and nonmagical solid barriers, ignore difficult terrain and cannot be targeted by attacks or effects that require a physical target. You may activate one other known Revelation at its normal RC cost while in spirit form. You cannot manipulate physical objects or make weapon attacks. At turn end choose your original space or a legal unoccupied space you reached; if none is legal, return to the original space. Your physical body remains in its original space and can still be attacked normally; damage and conditions on either form affect your one character. The optional Revelation uses its normal activation and cost: this feature grants no free Action. Ending in an occupied or illegal space returns the spirit to its body.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Echo Armor
extraCards.frequency: Damage reduction always; death prevention 1/short rest
extraCards.effect: Reduce the first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by PB, minimum 0. Once per short rest, when damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP instead. The prevention removes no Wounds and cannot trigger if another effect has already prevented that same reduction to 0.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Ghost Chant
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies of your choice within 3 tiles
extraCards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. At the end of that turn it repeats the save, ending Dread on success; failure extends Dread one final round. This is fear-based and a creature immune to fear is immune.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Bloodline Convergence
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls, reduce the first damage they take each round by S and are immune to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Ancestor Revelation for 0 RC; it still uses its normal action type. When Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required. At most three chosen allies gain its aura. The free Tier I activation uses its ordinary action type and shares the two-Revelation ceiling.

extraCards.name: Ancestral Whispers
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on History checks and you cannot be Surprised while conscious. Once per long rest, spend 1 minute consulting your ancestors about one specific person, place, object or course of action. The Director provides one truthful cryptic clue drawn from knowledge the ancestral spirits could reasonably possess; they do not reveal unknowable future decisions.

extraCards.name: Ancestor Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose exactly one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Echo Voice: when Echo Voice triggers, you may spend 1 additional RC to let up to M qualifying allies within 5 tiles each reroll one failed roll caused by the same event, using +2. Enhanced Spirit Walk: Spirit Walk lasts until the end of your next regular turn, but you still may activate at most one additional Revelation during the extended walk. Enhanced Bloodline Convergence: remove its post-effect suffering Revelation backlash drawback.

extraCards.name: Ancestral Confluence
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation plus cost reduction until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: When activating a known Ancestor Revelation, reduce its RC cost to 0. Until the end of your next regular turn, your other Ancestor Revelations cost 1 less RC, minimum 0. A Revelation can receive this reduction once per activation and no free or reduced activation can recursively restore RC from its own copied effects.

extraCards.name: Echo Crowned
extraCards.cost: 0 RC to maintain spirits; Revelation costs normally unless stated
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; death prevention ally within 5 tiles
extraCards.frequency: Double-cast 1/long rest; each spirit may be sacrificed once per long rest
extraCards.effect: Maintain three named ancestral Echoes: Offense grants +1 on your first Revelation attack each round; Defense reduces the first damage you take each round by S; Utility grants advantage on one History, Insight or Perception check per round. Once per long rest, when you activate a known Revelation, you may pay its RC cost twice and resolve it twice as part of the same action against different legal targets; copied resolution cannot duplicate resource or action triggers. You may sacrifice one currently available Echo as a Reaction when an ally within 5 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP to leave that ally at 1 HP instead, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum. A sacrificed Echo provides no passive benefit until your next long rest.

extraCards.name: Battle Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When you or an ally reduces a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Summoned, trivial, friendly or repeatedly revived creatures do not qualify.

extraCards.name: Omen of the Host
extraCards.duration: Passive permanent; oath until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Gain +1 on your first weapon or Revelation attack roll each round, +1 on saves against Frightened and you cannot be Surprised while conscious. Once per short rest as a Bonus Action choose one ally within 3 tiles; it gains +2 initiative for the current encounter, advantage on its next attack before the start of your next turn and reduces the first damage it takes before then by S.

extraCards.name: Vanguard's Step
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self and one willing ally within 3 tiles
extraCards.duration: Movement instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: You and the ally may each immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before the start of your next turn by S. Until the end of the current turn, both of you gain advantage on your next opportunity attack, if any.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Host's Cry
extraCards.effect: Allies in range gain +S damage on one weapon hit per turn and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. Once during this Cry, when a qualifying ally reduces a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP, that ally regains 1d6 HP and you regain 1 RC, never above maximum. This special refund can occur only once per Host's Cry and still obeys the once-per-round RC recovery ceiling.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Mark of the Doomed
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy you can see within 5 tiles
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one active mark at a time
extraCards.effect: Mark the target. You and allies within 5 tiles gain +2 on attack rolls against it. The first critical hit against the marked creature during the mark deals +1d6 damage of the triggering attack's type. The marked creature cannot benefit from mundane concealment against you. Applying another Mark of the Doomed ends the previous mark.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Divine Fury
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a weapon or touch attack hits, add damage equal to half its unmodified base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. Your attacks ignore 1 point of flat DR. When you critically hit, the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Once during each of your turns while Fury lasts, after your first weapon or touch attack hits, you may make one additional weapon or touch attack as a Bonus Action if you have not already used a Bonus Action that turn; this is not an extra full Action.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Field Command
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 5 tiles; optional second ally within 5 tiles
extraCards.duration: Immediate action; protection until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Choose one willing ally. It may immediately use its Reaction to either move up to its Speed, make one ordinary weapon attack, or activate one class feature that normally uses an Action or Bonus Action. This counts as that creature's one possible additional full Action for the round where applicable. If it deals damage with the granted action, add S damage to one damage roll. It reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Before the command resolves, a second ally within range may move 1 tile without provoking opportunity attacks. The ally pays every ordinary resource cost, rest use and recharge and meets every prerequisite. This is one additional Action for the shared cap; it cannot activate an action-granting feature.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Relentless Strike
extraCards.duration: Attack bonus until next qualifying attack; Fear until end next turn
extraCards.frequency: Miss benefit stacks once; RC recovery at most once per round
extraCards.effect: When you miss with a weapon or touch attack, gain +1 on your next such attack roll before the end of your next regular turn. If that empowered attack hits, add S damage. A second miss does not increase the bonus. When you score a critical hit, regain 1 RC at most once per round and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Fury of the Host
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, each ally in range may once on its regular turn gain one additional full Action usable only for one ordinary weapon attack or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies also gain +1 on attack rolls and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. You gain +2 AC and immunity to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Battle Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. The first qualifying ally each round to reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP regains 1d6 HP. When the effect ends, you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attacks and saves and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required; choose at most three allies for its benefits. Each granted Action may make only one ordinary weapon attack or Dash, and cannot grant another action.

extraCards.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
extraCards.duration: Permanent; AC benefit against one attack
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on Perception and initiative rolls. Once per long rest when a visible enemy declares an attack against you or an ally within 5 tiles, use your Reaction before the roll; you and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack before the end of its current turn.

extraCards.name: Battle Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Host's Cry: its range becomes 6 tiles and its damage rider becomes +S+1 instead of +S. Enhanced Divine Fury: once per turn during Divine Fury, a third weapon or touch attack you make that turn may receive the Fury bonus damage, but the feature creates no additional attack beyond its printed Bonus Action attack. Enhanced Fury of the Host: remove its suffering Revelation backlash drawback.

extraCards.name: War Prophecy
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One known Battle Revelation; allies within 5 tiles
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; aura until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Battle Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, allies within 5 tiles reduce the first damage they take by 1 and add S damage to one weapon hit. Your next Tier I Battle Revelation before the encounter ends costs 0 RC. That free Revelation cannot itself create another free-use chain.

extraCards.name: Avatar of the War Chorus
extraCards.effect: Manifest three banners for 3 rounds. Offense Banner: once on each of your turns add 2S damage to one weapon or Revelation damage roll. Defense Banner: gain +2 AC; allies within 5 tiles reduce first damage each round by 1. Rally Banner: once per round one ally within 5 tiles gains +1 on an attack roll made during its turn. Your known Tier I Battle Revelations cost 0 RC while all three banners remain. You may sacrifice one banner as a Reaction to leave an ally within 5 tiles at 1 HP instead of 0, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum; that banner's benefit ends immediately. When the 3-round effect ends naturally, regain 2 RC, never above maximum. The Final grants no more than one additional full Action per creature per round.

extraCards.name: Bones Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When an undead creature or meaningful hostile creature at 0 HP within 5 tiles dies, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Summoned, friendly, trivial or repeatedly revived creatures cannot trigger this recovery.

extraCards.name: Grave Attendant
extraCards.effect: Uncontrolled undead within 3 tiles that have no specific reason to attack you begin neutral rather than automatically hostile, and you reduce the first necrotic damage you take each round by PB. Once per long rest as an Action animate one Small or Medium corpse within 2 tiles as a 1-HP skeletal attendant for up to 3 rounds. It cannot attack. Once before it expires, when a single-target attack would hit you, the attendant intercepts it and is destroyed. It grants no XP, loot, corpse resource or RC.

extraCards.name: Bone Whisper
extraCards.cost: 1 RC for active suppression; corpse speech costs 0 RC
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One corpse touched; undead within 2 tiles for active effect
extraCards.duration: Corpse conversation maximum 1 minute; suppression until end of your next turn
extraCards.frequency: Corpse speech 1/corpse; active at will while RC remains
extraCards.effect: You may ask a corpse up to three brief questions about events it personally perceived while alive; it answers from its own knowledge and cannot speculate. Separately, spend 1 RC as an Action; undead enemies within 2 tiles make Wisdom saves. On failure they would be Incapacitated until the end of your next turn, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. On a later qualifying failure after the guard has been used, they instead lose Reactions and their Speed becomes 0 for that duration.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Marrow Drain
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; healing lock until end of your next turn against undead
extraCards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit deal 2d6 necrotic damage and regain HP equal to half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum S+M HP. Against undead, deal 3d6 necrotic instead and the target cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. Constructs are immune to the healing-drain portion. This healing removes no Wounds.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Ashen Shroud
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles; corpses within 2 tiles when effect ends
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds reduce the first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by S and reduce the first necrotic damage you take each round by S. Enemies within 2 tiles suffer -1 on attack rolls and -1 on saves against fear. When the Shroud ends, corpses within 2 tiles cannot be raised or converted into undead for 1 hour unless an effect specifically overrides Oracle corpse wards.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Ledger's Command
extraCards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save if hostile or unwilling; willing undead may waive it. On failure you command it for 2 rounds. Once per round as a Bonus Action, command one controlled undead to move up to its Speed and make one ordinary attack, using its own statistics; this obeys the universal one-extra-action limit and all controlled undead share that single Bonus Action command. Controlled undead reduce their first damage each round by 1. Once during the command, one controlled expendable undead may intercept a single-target attack against you and be reduced to 0 HP after absorbing it. This feature creates no corpse, loot or RC farm. Eligible targets are nonlegendary undead of challenge rating no greater than half your Oracle level (round down), with Wisdom saves initially and at each turn end. Commanding uses your shared companion Bonus Action; only one commanded undead makes one attack per round, capped at S d8+M damage with no monster multiattack, recharge or spell resources. Commanding a hostile undead to spend its Action consumes its one hard-denial allowance; later control can only deny Reactions and reduce Speed to 0 on a failed save, never command another Action.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Rotting Touch
extraCards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it gains Decay for up to 3 rounds: attacks against it add S damage once per attacker per turn, it takes -1 on saving throws and cannot regain HP. At the end of each turn it repeats the save, ending Decay on success. Corpses within 2 tiles of a Decayed creature cannot be raised while Decay persists. If the target is undead, it also takes 2d6 necrotic damage on the initial hit and you regain half the actual damage dealt, capped at S+M HP. At most three allied hits per round receive the vulnerability rider; it is additional flat damage, not multiplication of an entire attack.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Death's Threshold
extraCards.duration: Until healed above half maximum HP
extraCards.effect: The first time after a short rest that you fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, activate Death's Threshold. Until you are healed above half maximum HP, reduce the first necrotic damage and first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by S and gain +1 to your Revelation save DC. Undead enemies within 3 tiles take -1 on their first attack roll against you each round. The effect then ends and cannot reactivate until after another short rest.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Unfinished Chorus
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies, controlled undead and corpses within 4 tiles
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. Once on each of your turns choose one living enemy in range; it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you either regain half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, or one living ally within 3 tiles of you regains that amount, maximum S+M HP. Undead you control add S damage to one attack each turn and reduce first damage each round by 1. Corpses in the area cannot be raised while the Chorus lasts. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet. Choose up to three enemies and three allies. Enemies make Wisdom saves on entry and at the end of each turn, ending their debuff on success. The drain allows a Constitution save for half damage; healing is capped at S+M total per pulse. Concentration and pulse upkeep apply.

extraCards.name: Ledger's Memory
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on checks to identify undead, poison and disease. Once per long rest, touch one corpse and learn its identity if the Pale Ledger could reasonably know it, its approximate time of death and the direct physical or magical cause of death. This does not reveal the killer's identity unless the corpse or supernatural Ledger actually knows it.

extraCards.name: Bones Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Marrow Drain: a living target hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Ledger's Command: may target up to 3 undead, but all controlled undead still share one Bonus Action command per round. Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: when its drain resolves, you may always redirect the healing to one ally within 3 tiles of you rather than yourself; its healing cap remains S+M.

extraCards.name: Death's Prophecy
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One known Bones Revelation; self and allies within 3 tiles
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; ward until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Bones Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, you and allies within 3 tiles reduce the first necrotic damage you each take by S. This ward is damage reduction, not immunity, and does not stack with itself.

extraCards.name: Ledger Unbound
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies and up to 3 eligible corpses within 5 tiles
extraCards.effect: Choose up to three enemies in range. Roll 4S d8+M once; each target takes necrotic damage equal to the lesser of that roll or one-quarter its maximum HP, with a Constitution save for half. This blast cannot reduce HP below 1. Raise up to three nonsummoned corpses as 1-HP bone servants for three rounds. Once per round spend your shared companion Bonus Action to move and attack with ONE servant using your Revelation attack bonus for 1d8+S necrotic damage. Alternatively, your Reaction may sacrifice one servant to intercept a single-target attack against you; no attack is made by that servant that round. Servants grant no XP, loot, harvestable corpses or RC. For three rounds, up to three undead you already control add S damage to their one shared commanded attack and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. No extra creature turns or command budgets are created.

extraCards.name: Cataclysm Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When one of your Revelations deals damage to at least two meaningful hostile creatures as part of the same area effect, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Repeated pulses of the same Revelation can trigger this at most once per round.

extraCards.name: Tremor Sense
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles for tremor
extraCards.duration: Permanent; tremor penalties until end of your next turn
extraCards.effect: While touching the ground or a structure, you can identify obvious structural instability, hollow spaces and hidden passages within 3 tiles that transmit vibration, subject to ordinary concealment and construction. Reduce the first bludgeoning damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest as an Action, enemies within 2 tiles make Strength saves; on failure they fall Prone, and on success their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of your next turn.

extraCards.name: Shardburst
extraCards.duration: Damage instantaneous; Speed reduction until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If a failing creature is adjacent to a wall, rubble or substantial stone terrain, it also makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Gale of Unmaking
extraCards.duration: Damage/movement instantaneous; difficult terrain until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Enemies in the line make Strength saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 1 tile on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Failed targets also have Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of their next turn. Mundane exposed flames in the line are extinguished. Loose natural debris in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Fault Line
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: 3-tile line of ground beginning within 4 tiles
extraCards.effect: The line becomes difficult terrain for 3 rounds. The first time each round an enemy enters the line or starts its turn there, it takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and, if adjacent to a wall or substantial structure, makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone. Ordinary structures along the line may develop superficial or tactical cracks at Director discretion, but the Revelation cannot automatically destroy major structures or bypass scenario-critical barriers.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Upheaval
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; ally protection until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Strength saves. On failure they take 2d6+M bludgeoning damage and fall Prone; on success they take half damage and remain standing. Allies you choose in the burst are immune to this Prone effect and reduce the first damage they take before the start of your next turn by 1. Structures may crack at Director discretion but are not automatically destroyed.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Storm Crown
extraCards.effect: Choose lightning or thunder when activated. At the start of each of your regular turns while Storm Crown persists, enemies within 3 tiles make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage of the chosen type on failure or half on success. A creature failing the save takes -1 on its first attack roll that turn. Allies in the aura reduce the first ranged-attack damage they take each round by 1 and have advantage on saves against weather-based Prone effects.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Instability
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Creatures within 1 tile of you after an enemy damages you
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; ally protection until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: When an enemy deals actual damage to you, spend 1 RC. Hostile creatures within 1 tile make Strength saves. Each takes force damage equal to half the actual triggering damage rounded down, maximum Oracle level, on failure or half that amount on success; a failing creature also falls Prone. Allies within the burst take no damage and reduce their first damage before the start of your next turn by 1. Reflected damage cannot trigger another reflection, RC refund or recursive damage effect.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Seal's Fracture
extraCards.effect: Choose Earthquake, Storm or Fire. The zone becomes difficult terrain. At activation and at the start of your next regular turn, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage on failure or half on success: bludgeoning for Earthquake, lightning for Storm, fire for Fire. Until the zone ends, enemies inside take -1 on saving throws against your Cataclysm Revelations; allies inside reduce first damage each round by 1 and cannot be knocked Prone by this zone. Difficult terrain expands 1 tile outward after the second pulse but deals no extra damage there. Structures may crack at Director discretion. When the effect ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

extraCards.name: Wound of Creation
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving geology, storms, earthquakes, structural stability and unstable terrain. Once per long rest spend an Action to sense the nearest significant structural weak point, unstable surface, hidden fracture or likely collapse point within 10 tiles that is physically connected to your surroundings. You learn direction and broad nature, not an automatic method to destroy it.

extraCards.name: Cataclysm Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Shardburst: increase its burst radius by 1 tile. Enhanced Upheaval: allies in the burst are also immune to Prone from other nonmagical ground effects until the start of your next turn. Enhanced Seal's Fracture: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains a third normal pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; repeat saves occur normally.

extraCards.name: Cataclysm Prophecy
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; empowerment until one later qualifying area resolves
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Cataclysm Revelation for 0 RC. Before the encounter ends, the next damaging area effect created by one of your Cataclysm Revelations adds one extra die matching its primary damage die to one shared damage roll. Creatures failing that effect's normal save also make a Strength save; failure knocks them Prone. Structures may crack at Director discretion but are not automatically destroyed.

extraCards.name: The Unbound Wound
extraCards.effect: Create a cataclysm zone. At activation and at the start of each of your next two regular turns, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves. Roll 2S d8 once each pulse; half the rolled damage is bludgeoning and half, rounded down, is your choice of fire, lightning or force. Failure takes full damage; success takes half. The zone is difficult terrain and creatures failing by 10 or more also fall Prone. For the duration you are immune to force and bludgeoning damage originating from your own Cataclysm Revelations and resistant to other force/bludgeoning damage. Major structures are affected only according to Director-defined durability, never automatically erased. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn.

extraCards.name: Dream Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When one of your Dream Revelations successfully imposes a condition or creates an illusion that a meaningful hostile creature fails a save against, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple targets failing the same Revelation restore only 1 RC.

extraCards.name: Dreamer's Veil
extraCards.effect: Gain +1 on saves against Charm and Illusion effects and advantage on saves against magical sleep. Once per long rest as an Action, choose one willing ally within 3 tiles; it becomes Invisible until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or 2 rounds pass. The first damaging attack it lands while still benefiting from concealment adds S d6 psychic damage. The bonus occurs once per use.

extraCards.name: Mirage
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One unoccupied space within 3 tiles of you
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Mirage at a time
extraCards.effect: Create one illusory duplicate. Once each round when a creature that can see the duplicate targets you with an attack, it makes a Wisdom save before rolling. On failure it targets the Mirage instead; the attack automatically misses you and destroys the Mirage. On success it targets normally. At the start of each of your turns the Mirage may move 1 tile without provoking. Area effects ignore the duplicate.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Slumber Glimpse
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and takes -2 on its next initiative adjustment or initiative check before the end of the encounter. The next attack against it before the end of its next turn gains +2 to hit. On a target already protected by the hard-control guard, failure instead removes Reactions and reduces Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: False Memory
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn or until plainly disproven
extraCards.effect: Describe one brief plausible false event concerning the immediate scene, such as an ally moving away, a door opening or a visible attack already occurring. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it treats that event as true for tactical perception only until disproven or the duration ends; it loses Reactions and the next attack against it gains +2 to hit. The illusion cannot overwrite identity, compel self-harm, create permanent memories, change beliefs or force the target to surrender possessions.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Shared Dream
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 2 willing allies within 4 tiles
extraCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until each target acts
extraCards.effect: Each target may immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks and gains concealment until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or the duration ends. The first damaging attack each target lands while concealed by Shared Dream adds S psychic damage once. This movement is not an additional full Action.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Nightmare Lash
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and no Reactions until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save then; failure extends the attack/save penalty one final round, but Reaction loss lasts only the first round. If the target was already Frightened or suffering Dread before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and, after resolution, regain 1 RC at most once per round.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Unreality
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; attacker within normal attack range
extraCards.frequency: Passive avoidance once per round; vanish 1/short rest
extraCards.effect: Once per round when an enemy attack roll would hit you, roll d4; on4 the attack instead hits an illusory echo and misses. Separately, once per short rest when an attack would deal damage to you, use your Reaction before damage to make that attack miss and teleport to an unoccupied space 1 tile away that you can perceive. The attacker then makes a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Threshold Collapse
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies in the aura take -1 on attack rolls and cannot gain advantage solely from flanking. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per round at the start of one enemy's turn in the aura, choose that enemy; it makes a Wisdom save. On failure choose one ally in the aura: that enemy treats the chosen ally as visually absent until the start of its next turn and cannot target that ally with attacks requiring sight, though area effects remain legal. When a hostile creature makes the first save to disbelieve one of your Dream illusions inside the aura, success requires a second Wisdom save; failing either means it remains deceived for that illusion's normal duration.

extraCards.name: Lucid Oracle
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against magical sleep and Illusion effects. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking the Veiled Threshold one specific question concerning the present situation or a contemplated course of action. Receive one truthful symbolic vision or omen. It cannot reveal another player's unknowable future choice.

extraCards.name: Dream Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Mirage: create two duplicates; each can absorb one failed-targeting attack and both share the same 2-round duration. Enhanced Shared Dream: affect up to 3 allies plus yourself. Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies inside the aura cannot take Reactions while they are currently deceived by one of your Dream illusions or while suffering Dread from you.

extraCards.name: Dream Prophecy
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; invisibility until attack or end of next turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Dream Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or the end of your next regular turn. The first damaging attack you land from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage and causes the target to make a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn. During the same interval, when a creature succeeds on its first save to disbelieve one illusion you create, require a second Wisdom save; it must succeed on both to disbelieve.

extraCards.name: The Waking Lie
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 4 contiguous tiles within 6 tiles
extraCards.effect: Designate up to 4 contiguous tiles as dream-space for 3 rounds. Allies in those tiles have concealment. When an enemy first tries each round to directly target an ally in dream-space using sight, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure that ally appears absent and cannot be the target of that specific attack or sight-dependent effect, though the enemy may choose another legal target or use an area effect. On success it perceives normally for that attempt. When the dream-space ends, enemies currently inside make Wisdom saves, taking 3S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success. This cannot erase terrain, creatures, memory, ownership or objective reality.

extraCards.name: Flame Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When one of your Revelations restores HP to a living ally or deals fire damage to a meaningful hostile creature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. One Revelation use can restore at most 1 RC even if it both heals and burns or affects multiple targets.

extraCards.name: Ember Mantle
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles during ignition
extraCards.effect: Gain fire resistance and add S HP to the first external healing effect that restores HP to you each round. Once per long rest ignite the Mantle for 2 rounds. Once per round when a creature within melee reach damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 fire damage. You shed bright light in 2 tiles, and allies there gain +1 on saves against Frightened.

extraCards.name: Wrathful Brand
extraCards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Brand at a time
extraCards.effect: Mark one enemy. The next damaging attack you hit it with before the Brand ends adds fire damage equal to half that attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If an ally damages the marked target before the Brand ends, that ally regains 1d6 HP once per Brand and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Purging Flame
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; attack penalty until end of undead target's next turn
extraCards.effect: If the target is a living ally, it regains 1d8+M HP and may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease that normally permits saves. This removes no Wounds. If the target is undead, make a Revelation attack; on hit it takes 1d8+M fire damage and makes a Constitution save, suffering -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn on failure.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Passion's Rush
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; move up to 3 tiles in a straight or bending legal path
extraCards.duration: Movement instantaneous; ally buff until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Move up to 3 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. Each meaningful hostile creature whose space you pass adjacent to can be affected once and makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; a failed target also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If you finish adjacent to an ally, that ally adds S damage to its next weapon hit and reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Crown's Burn
extraCards.duration: Damage/healing instantaneous; penalties until end of next turn
extraCards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing enemy also has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Total the actual fire damage dealt to meaningful hostile creatures, then divide by the number of allied recipients chosen in the burst; up to three living allies in the burst each regain the lesser of that share or S d6+M HP, minimum 1 if any qualifying damage was dealt. Each healed ally reduces the first fire damage it takes before your next turn by S.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Zealot's Renewal
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One living ally within 3 tiles; adjacent enemies
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; fire ward until start of your next turn
extraCards.effect: The ally regains 2S d8+M HP, then takes 1d4 fire backlash that cannot be reduced below 1 unless First Flame Convergence suppresses it. It may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Until the start of your next turn it reduces the first fire damage it takes by S. Hostile creatures adjacent to the healed ally take 1d4 fire damage once from scattering embers.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Undying Ember
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies adjacent to you; allies within 2 tiles
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; enemy penalty until end of next turn
extraCards.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP. Adjacent enemies make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; failing enemies also take -1 on attack rolls until the end of their next turn. Up to three living allies within 2 tiles each regain 1d6 HP. This removes no Wounds and cannot trigger from self-inflicted staged damage.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: First Flame Convergence
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a Flame Revelation deals fire damage, add one extra die matching that Revelation's primary damage die to one damage roll. Once per turn when one of your Flame Revelations damages a meaningful hostile creature, one living ally within 4 tiles regains 1d6 HP. Allies within 4 tiles are immune to Frightened. Once per turn when this effect heals an ally, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Zealot's Renewal deals no backlash while Convergence lasts.

extraCards.name: Founder's Memory
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar, the Crown of First Flame and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest after failing a saving throw against fire damage or Frightened, reroll that save and use the new result.

extraCards.name: Flame Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Wrathful Brand: its maximum duration becomes 2 rounds. Enhanced Crown's Burn: its healing may target up to three living allies within 4 tiles of the burst center rather than requiring them inside the burst. Enhanced First Flame Convergence: Zealot's Renewal backlash remains suppressed for the full Convergence duration; if already suppressed by the base effect, additionally one ally healed by Zealot's Renewal during Convergence gains S temporary HP.

extraCards.name: Flame Prophecy
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One known Flame Revelation; allies within 4 tiles
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; secondary effects until end of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Flame Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, the next Zealot's Renewal or other Flame Revelation you use that has self-damaging healing backlash ignores that backlash, and allies within 4 tiles reduce the first fire damage they take by S. The next time you damage a creature already suffering ongoing fire damage before the effect ends, add S fire damage once.

extraCards.name: Crown Restored
extraCards.effect: Manifest the Crown for 3 rounds. Once on each of your turns add 2 fire damage to one damaging attack or Revelation.
