At the start of each living ally's turn within 5 tiles, including yours, that ally regains 1d6 HP, at most three pulses per creature from this Final and never above maximum HP. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Flame Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. Free Revelations cannot recursively restore additional RC beyond the normal once-per-round Prophecy Trigger cap.

extraCards.name: Life Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When you restore at least 1 actual HP to a living ally other than through a copied, reflected or staged healing event, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Healing multiple allies from one effect still restores only 1 RC that round.

extraCards.name: Bloom Ward
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles; one ally within 3 tiles for bloom
extraCards.duration: Passive permanent; bloom until consumed or 1 minute
extraCards.effect: Once per round when a living ally within 2 tiles receives HP healing from a paid or finite-use effect, add S HP to that healing. Reduce the first necrotic or poison damage you take each round by 1. Once per long rest place a protective bloom on one ally within 3 tiles. It absorbs the next 10+Oracle level damage dealt to that ally, then ends. When it ends, the ally gains +1 on saves against Frightened until the end of its next turn.

extraCards.name: Overflowing Light
extraCards.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. Healing exceeding its maximum becomes temporary HP, maximum 10, lasting 2 rounds. When those temporary HP expire naturally, if at least 1 remains the target may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered. This cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or convert deliberately wasted healing into more than 10 temporary HP.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Resonant Seed
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
extraCards.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Thorned Shelter
extraCards.effect: The target gains +2 AC and reduces the first damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when it receives HP healing from another finite effect, add 1 HP. The first melee attacker to damage it each round takes 1d4 piercing damage and must make a Strength save; on failure its Speed becomes 0 until the end of that current turn. This movement restriction is not a full-turn denial.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Garden of Restoration
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Garden at a time
extraCards.effect: At the start of each living ally's turn in the Garden, it regains 1d6 HP, maximum three pulses per creature from this use, and gains +1 HP the next time another finite healing effect restores HP before its next turn. The first time each ally enters or starts in a given Garden, it may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Undead starting in the Garden take 1d6 radiant damage and make a Wisdom save; on failure they take -1 on attack rolls until the end of that turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Life Linked
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally within 5 tiles
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Life Link at a time
extraCards.effect: Link yourself to the ally. Once per round when it takes damage, you may use your Reaction to transfer up to half that actual damage rounded down to yourself. Transferred damage keeps its type and cannot be redirected again. The ally reduces the first necrotic damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to the linked ally, it regains an additional 1d4 HP. The link ends if you are more than 5 tiles apart. Apply mitigation to the original damage once before splitting. The transferred portion cannot be mitigated again and cannot generate recovery or retaliation triggers.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Verdant Pulse
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Allies you heal; emergency ally within 4 tiles
extraCards.duration: Buff until end of ally's next turn; emergency instantaneous
extraCards.frequency: Buff once per ally per short rest; emergency 1/encounter
extraCards.effect: When one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to an ally who was below half maximum HP, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before the end of its next turn by S and adds 1 HP to one later finite healing effect during that period. Separately, once per encounter when a living ally within 4 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP without instant death, use your Reaction to leave it at 1 HP instead and end Frightened or Poisoned on it.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Song of Mending
extraCards.effect: On activation and at the start of your next regular turn, each living ally still within 5 tiles regains 2d6 HP, for exactly two possible pulses per use. Once during the duration for each ally, when one damage event would reduce it below 1 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. When this prevention triggers, that ally may end Frightened or Poisoned and gains +S HP the next time a separate finite healing effect restores HP before Song ends. This removes no Wounds and cannot resurrect.

extraCards.name: Bloom Oracle
extraCards.frequency: Skill benefit always; supernatural diagnosis 1/long rest
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on Medicine and Nature checks. Once per long rest, examine one willing creature for 1 minute and learn the broad nature of one disease, poison, curse-like affliction or bodily condition affecting it plus one plausible mundane, magical or quest-based countermeasure known to the Verdant Resonance. This identifies rather than automatically cures the condition.

extraCards.name: Life Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Overflowing Light: maximum temporary HP from excess healing becomes 20. Enhanced Garden of Restoration: the first Garden pulse a creature receives may end both Poisoned and one disease that explicitly allows magical curing, rather than only one of those benefits. Enhanced Song of Mending: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains one additional 2d6 healing pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; each ally still receives only one 1-HP death prevention per use.

extraCards.name: Life Prophecy
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One known Life Revelation; allies you heal
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; empowerment until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Life Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, when one of your paid, finite or Prophetic-Surge Life effects rolls healing dice, treat each healing die as its maximum value. Each ally you heal during this period gains +S HP from the next separate finite healing effect it receives before the end of its next turn. Once per round when you heal an ally, undead within 3 tiles of that ally take 1d4 radiant damage. This radiant damage cannot trigger healing or RC recursively.

extraCards.name: Eternal Bloom
extraCards.effect: When Eternal Bloom appears, record each living ally's missing HP while it is inside the zone. Divide that recorded missing HP into three healing installments as evenly as possible, with any remainder assigned to earlier pulses. On activation and at the start of each of your next two regular turns, each qualifying ally still inside regains its next installment; later damage does not increase this reserve. Once per ally during the Bloom, when damage would reduce it to 0 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. Allies in the zone have necrotic immunity for the 3 rounds. When the Bloom ends, petals create light obscurement in the zone until the start of your next turn. It removes no Wounds and does not resurrect.

extraCards.name: Shadow Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When you damage a meaningful hostile creature that cannot see you or is currently Frightened or suffering Dread from your Oracle feature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple qualifying hits during the same round restore only 1 RC.

extraCards.name: Umbral Cloak
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness and reduce the first psychic damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or 2 rounds pass. The first damaging attack you land while benefiting from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage, once per use.

extraCards.name: Psychic Lash
extraCards.duration: Damage instantaneous; Dread until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit deal 1d8+M psychic damage. If the target could not see you when the attack began, add one extra d8 psychic damage; it also makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers Dread (-1 on attack rolls and saving throws) and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Fear's Whisper
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, cannot willingly move closer to you and loses Reactions for that first round. Allies gain +1 on attack rolls against it while this Frightened condition lasts. At the end of its turn it repeats the save, ending the condition on success; failure extends it one final round without extending Reaction loss.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Shadow Step
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; unoccupied space in dim light or darkness within 3 tiles
extraCards.duration: Teleport instantaneous; empowerment until end of current turn
extraCards.effect: Teleport to the chosen legal space without provoking opportunity attacks. Until the end of the turn, if you make a damaging attack while the target cannot see you or while you are concealed, add S d6 psychic damage to that attack once. Shadow Step itself does not make you Invisible.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Night's Embrace
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one zone at a time
extraCards.effect: Allies in the zone gain concealment and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. Enemies in the zone take -1 on attack rolls and -1 on saves against your Fear/Dread effects. The first damaging attack you make from inside the zone each round while concealed adds S d6 psychic damage. When an enemy first enters the zone during a round, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it loses Reactions until the end of that turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Mind Spike
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure it cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn and suffers Dread (-1 attacks and saves). It repeats the save at the end of that turn; failure extends Dread one final round but not Reaction loss. If already Frightened or Dreaded before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Silent Hunter
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; first qualifying enemy each encounter
extraCards.duration: Permanent; Dread until end next turn
extraCards.frequency: Damage rider once per encounter; reposition once per round
extraCards.effect: The first damaging attack you hit with during an encounter while concealed from its target adds S d6 psychic damage; the target makes a Wisdom save and suffers Dread (-1 attacks and saves) until the end of its next turn on failure. Separately, once per round after you activate a Revelation while concealed, move 1 tile without provoking opportunity attacks and gain +1 on your next attack roll before the end of the current turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Shadow; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Hush Descends
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds sound is suppressed in the aura. Hostile creatures cannot use abilities that explicitly require audible speech or verbal spell components and suffer Dread (-1 on attack rolls and saves). You and allies gain +1 on attack rolls made while concealed. At the start of each enemy's turn in the aura it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it would lose its Action to nameless dread, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. Once per round, the first psychic Revelation you activate while inside the aura costs 1 less RC, minimum 0; a 0-RC activation cannot independently generate recursive resource refunds.

extraCards.name: Shadow Oracle
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one creature within 3 tiles that you can perceive
extraCards.frequency: Skill benefits always; fear reading 1/long rest
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on Stealth and Insight checks. Once per long rest choose one creature within 3 tiles and spend an Action reading its surface fear. If the creature is not protected from mind-reading or divination, the Director truthfully identifies one present fear, dread or aversion known to that creature. This grants information only and does not compel behavior.

extraCards.name: Shadow Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Psychic Lash: range becomes 7 tiles. Enhanced Night's Embrace: allies inside also gain +1 AC while concealed by the zone. Enhanced Hush Descends: duration becomes 3 rounds; enemies continue receiving the normal start-of-turn save each round and each target remains subject to the hard-control guard.

extraCards.name: Shadow Prophecy
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; invisibility until attack or end of next turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Shadow Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or the end of your next regular turn. The first damaging attack you land from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage and forces a Wisdom save; failure inflicts Dread (-1 attacks and saves) until the end of the target's next turn.

extraCards.name: Marquis's Glimpse
extraCards.effect: For 3 rounds, ranged attack rolls against you automatically miss unless the attacker is adjacent to you or has an effect explicitly ignoring supernatural concealment. Once on each of your turns when a psychic Revelation deals damage, add a second copy of its unmodified rolled damage dice to one target; this copied damage cannot trigger RC recovery, conditions or proc effects. At the start of each enemy's turn within 4 tiles it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it would lose its Action to nameless dread, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. A creature already hard-denied by you this encounter instead loses its Reaction and has Speed 0 until end of that turn.

extraCards.name: Stars Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When a Revelation you activated grants an ally advantage or a reroll and that ally uses the granted advantage or reroll, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple allies using the same effect in one round restore only 1 RC.

extraCards.name: Starlight Mantle
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; 4-tile light zone centered on you
extraCards.duration: Passive while under open sky or at night; light 2 rounds
extraCards.effect: While under open sky at night or in visible starlight, gain +1 on ranged attack rolls and +1 to your Revelation save DC. Reduce the first radiant damage you take each round by 1. Once per long rest create starlight in a 4-tile radius for 2 rounds. Invisible and ethereal creatures in the light are revealed to you unless protected by stronger supernatural concealment. Allies in the light gain +2 on their next attack roll during the effect.

extraCards.name: Guiding Bolt
extraCards.duration: Damage instantaneous; star-mark 2 rounds or until consumed
extraCards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit deal 2d6+M radiant damage and apply a star-mark for up to 2 rounds. The next ally other than you to make an attack against the marked target gains +2 on that attack roll. If it hits, add S radiant damage and consume the mark. A creature can carry only one of your star-marks at a time.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Fate's Glimpse
extraCards.duration: Until end of ally's next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Before the duration ends, when the chosen ally fails one attack roll, saving throw or ability check, it may reroll with +2 and must use the new result. If the reroll succeeds, you gain advantage on your next Revelation attack before the end of your next regular turn. You do not roll another creature’s saving throw. No Oracle feature rerolls the same roll twice; this reroll cannot trigger another reroll.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Clarity
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 4 tiles; 2-tile reveal radius around target
extraCards.duration: Cleanse instantaneous; save bonus 2 rounds; reveal 1 round
extraCards.effect: End one Charmed, Frightened or illusion-based condition on the target. For 2 rounds it gains +1 on saving throws. Until the end of your next regular turn, shapeshifted, invisible and ethereal creatures within 2 tiles of the target are revealed to it unless protected by an effect explicitly defeating supernatural revelation.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Constellation Mark
extraCards.effect: Mark up to two enemies. Allies gain +2 on attack rolls against marked targets. The first critical hit each round against any one of your marked targets deals +1d6 radiant damage. A marked creature cannot benefit from mundane concealment against creatures that can perceive your starlight mark. Recasting ends your previous Constellation Marks.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Radiant Path
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: 5-tile line originating from you; enemies and up to 3 allies in line
extraCards.duration: Instantaneous; star-ash until end of your next turn
extraCards.effect: Enemies in the line make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M radiant damage on failure or half on success. Failed enemies are covered in star-ash until the end of your next turn and cannot benefit from mundane concealment. Choose up to three living allies in the line; roll 1d6 once and each regains that much HP if at least one meaningful hostile took damage, maximum healing per ally S+M if lower. After resolution, you and one chosen ally in the line may each move 1 tile along the Path without provoking opportunity attacks.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Omen Reader
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 5 tiles; one enemy identified at initiative
extraCards.effect: When initiative is rolled, the Director identifies the visible hostile creature with the highest current attack bonus among creatures you can perceive. You and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC against that creature's first attack each round. Once per encounter before that enemy rolls its first attack of a turn, impose -2 on the roll and mark it with star-ash until the end of its next turn; allies gain +1 on attacks against it while marked.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Stars; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Concord Alignment
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls and advantage on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per turn when an ally within range fails an attack roll or saving throw, use your Reaction to let that ally reroll it and use the new result; only one reroll can be granted per round. During Alignment, Guiding Bolt and Constellation Mark ranges increase by 1 tile. No roll can be rerolled more than once by Oracle features.

extraCards.name: Stellar Oracle
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving astronomy, astrology and navigation. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes reading the sky or a divination focus concerning one specific party decision. The Director supplies one truthful but cryptic omen about a likely consequence known to the Celestial Concord. It cannot dictate another player's future decision or guarantee an outcome.

extraCards.name: Stars Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Guiding Bolt: a creature hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Constellation Mark: may mark up to 3 enemies. Enhanced Concord Alignment: duration becomes 3 rounds and its reroll cadence remains once per round.

extraCards.name: Star Prophecy
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One known Stars Revelation; allies within 5 tiles
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Stars Revelation for 0 RC. For 2 rounds allies within 5 tiles gain +2 initiative for any initiative reordering and +1 on their first attack roll each turn. Once during this period choose one ally within range as a Bonus Action; it gains advantage on its next attack roll before the effect ends.

extraCards.name: Concord Unveiled
extraCards.effect: For 3 rounds you cannot be Surprised and gain +2 AC against the first attack made against you each round. Your Stars Revelations cost 1 less RC, minimum 0. Once per round when one ally within 6 tiles fails a saving throw, you may use your Reaction to turn that failed save into a success. This cannot convert a natural result into a critical success, override immunity requirements or trigger another save-copy/resource-refund chain.

extraCards.name: Time Prophecy Trigger
extraCards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
extraCards.effect: When one of your Time Revelations meaningfully changes a creature's initiative position or grants an ally a reroll and that reroll is used, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple qualifying creatures or rerolls in the same round restore only 1 RC.

extraCards.name: Spiral Echo
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one incoming attack, spell or condition effect
extraCards.duration: Passive permanent; delayed effect until start of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Gain +2 initiative. Once initiative order is established, hostile effects cannot move your initiative slot later unless they explicitly overcome temporal immunity. Once per short rest when an attack, spell or condition effect would resolve solely against you, use your Reaction to delay its resolution until the start of your next regular turn. Record the original attack roll, save DC, damage roll and effect exactly; no resources are refunded and the source need not remain present. At the start of your next turn, before actions, resolve the recorded effect against you using the recorded values, then you may move 1 tile without provoking. Delaying creates no copy or additional proc.

extraCards.name: Moment's Pause
extraCards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
extraCards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and is treated as acting one initiative step later for the next round only. If the target has already suffered a full-turn denial from you this encounter, failure instead removes its Reaction and reduces its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Echo Strike
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Same target just hit by your weapon or touch attack
extraCards.effect: Immediately after your weapon or touch attack hits, spend 1 RC. Copy half the triggering attack's unmodified rolled damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1, as damage of the same type to the same target. The echo is not another attack, cannot critically hit and copies no flat modifiers, conditions, resource gains or proc triggers. If this copied damage leaves the target below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round and never above maximum.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Borrowed Beat
extraCards.duration: Immediate movement/action; initiative bonus until end of next round
extraCards.effect: Choose one willing ally. It immediately chooses one: move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks, or activate one known Tier I Revelation or equivalent Tier-I Oracle Revelation it possesses using its Reaction and paying its normal RC cost. Any granted Revelation activation counts against that creature's one possible additional full Action for the round. You and that ally gain +2 to initiative ordering until the end of the next round.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Time; selected Tier I Revelation

extraCards.name: Rewind Wound
extraCards.duration: Healing instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; same damage event can be rewound once
extraCards.effect: Reference the most recent single damage event the target suffered since the start of its previous regular turn and restore HP equal to that event's actual HP damage, maximum Oracle level+M. If that exact event directly imposed one condition with a finite duration, remove that condition if it is still present and is not a Wound, curse, death state or permanent transformation. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1 and gains +2 initiative for the current round. If the recorded damage had reduced it below half maximum HP, regain 1 RC after resolution, at most once per round. Rewind does not undo attacks, spent resources, movement, deaths of other creatures or proc effects.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Temporal Rift
extraCards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Rift at a time
extraCards.effect: Enemies beginning their turn in the Rift act after all non-Rift creatures at the same initiative step for that round and take -1 on their first attack roll that turn. Allies beginning their turn there gain +2 for initiative-order comparisons and reduce the first damage from an effect that would remove or delay an Action by S. Once per Rift when an ally inside fails a saving throw, you may spend 1 RC as a Reaction to let it reroll with +2 and use the new result.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Paradox Skin
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one ally within 3 tiles for time-effect interception
extraCards.frequency: Echo avoidance once per round; ally reroll 1/short rest
extraCards.effect: Once per round when an attack would hit you, roll d10; on1 the attack instead hits a temporal echo and misses. You have advantage on saves against magical aging, Slow and explicitly time-based control. Once per short rest when an ally within 3 tiles fails a save against an aging, Slow or explicitly time-based effect, use your Reaction to let it reroll with +2 and use the new result.
extraCards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Time; selected Tier II Revelation

extraCards.name: Spiral Convergence
extraCards.effect: For 2 rounds, once per round when an ally within 5 tiles fails an attack roll, saving throw or ability check, use your Reaction to let that ally reroll and use the new result; this changes only the roll and does not refund resources, Actions, damage or proc triggers from events already resolved. Once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. An ally whose roll you rewind reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. If an enemy directly benefited from the original failed roll, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure it loses its Reaction until the end of its next turn. After Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

extraCards.name: Spiral Oracle
extraCards.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving history, prophecy and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking whether one specific contemplated action is likely to provoke a serious foreseeable disaster within the next day. The Director answers yes, no or unclear and provides one cryptic truthful hint. This does not reveal player choices or guarantee a deterministic future.

extraCards.name: Time Revelation Mastery
extraCards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Echo Strike: its copied damage equals the triggering attack's full unmodified rolled damage dice total instead of half; it still copies no modifiers, conditions, resources or proc triggers. Enhanced Rewind Wound: may target yourself. Enhanced Spiral Convergence: its additional full Action may use any normal Action type except one that grants another Action; the universal one-extra-Action cap remains.

extraCards.name: Time Prophecy
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: One known Time Revelation; allies within 5 tiles
extraCards.duration: Chosen Revelation; temporal benefit until end of your next regular turn
extraCards.effect: Activate one known Time Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, move your initiative position to immediately before the next hostile creature that has not yet acted this round; if all hostiles have acted, remain in your current position and act first among tied initiative positions next round. This never grants an immediate extra normal turn. Until the end of your next regular turn, allies within 5 tiles gain +2 on initiative-order comparisons and each may reroll one failed saving throw once, using the new result. These rerolls refund no resources or previously resolved consequences.

extraCards.name: The Spiral Opens
extraCards.rangeAndTarget: Self; one known beneficial Time Revelation or one enemy within 5 tiles
extraCards.effect: For 3 rounds, at the start of each of your regular turns choose ONE temporal option, each usable at most once during this Final. ECHO REVELATION: repeat only the immediate numeric damage, healing, movement or buff component of one beneficial Time Revelation you personally resolved during the previous round, paying 0 RC; this copy is not a new Revelation cast, copies no resource restoration, action grant, hard control, condition trigger, Prophecy Trigger or proc. FORCED ECHO: choose one non-player enemy within 5 tiles and one ordinary weapon attack or non-resource movement action it took during its previous turn. The enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure, during its next turn it must repeat that action pattern if legally possible, but it chooses all legal targets and paths; it spends no limited resources and cannot be forced to harm itself. A player-controlled creature instead, on a failed save, loses its Reaction and must choose either repeat one ordinary non-resource action type from its prior turn or have Speed reduced to 0 until turn end. Allies retain memory of all temporal echoes. This Final never creates more than one additional full Action for any creature in a round. There are only two options in this Final; after using both once, remaining rounds provide only the printed temporal presence, without another echo. An echoed healing amount also pays 1 RC or consumes an unused per-rest healing use; a temporal copy cannot create an uncosted healing reserve.
